subject: maths
question: An electric heater was sold at a profit of 12%. If its cost had been 5% less and it had been sold for ₹180 less, the profit would have been 10%. What is the cost price of the electric heater?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Let first cp = 100

⇒ first sp on 12% profit = 112

Now new cp at 5% less = 95

⇒ new sp = 95 x 110/100 = 104.5

Difference between first sp and new sp = Rs. 180

⇒ 112 - 104.5 = 180 ⇒ 7.5 = 180 ⇒ 1 = 24

⇒ cp = 100 x 24 = Rs. 2400
